{{Quote|Fool. If you think I'm going to be target practice for a rogue droid with a flamethrower, you're mistaken.|Arlain Zee, to Volan Das|<ref name="Lockdown (comic)">{{TCWComicCite|6.47|Lockdown (comic story)}}</ref>}}
'''M-1991''' was a [[Bugnaught]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] who operated during the waning [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. Circa [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], M-1991 was captured by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and [[Prison/Legends|imprisoned]] alongside other wanted bounty hunters aboard the [[Venator-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Venator''-class Star Destroyer]] ''[[Tempestuous]]'' for transporting to [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], the Republic [[Capital/Legends|capital]]. During the voyage, the prisoner [[Arlain Zee]] escaped from [[Gender/Legends|his]] cell and freed M-1991 and several other bounty hunters. While a large group of bounty hunters attacked their [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] guards, Zee, M-1991, the [[Gand/Legends|Gand]] [[Esu]], the [[Iktotchi/Legends|Iktotchi]] [[Volan Das/Legends|Volan Das]] and the [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] [[Kessk]] attempted to make their way to the [[Hangar/Legends|hangar]] bay in order to steal a [[Starship/Legends|starship]] and flee. However, M-1991 was soon [[Riot aboard the Tempestuous|recaptured]] by the [[Cloning/Legends|clones]], and on arrival to the destination-[[Planet/Legends|world]] of Coruscant, they was escorted off the ''Tempestuous'' along with Esu and Kessk by two clone [[Trooper/Legends|troopers]].
